verification: Anonymous Hugging Face metadata requests and primary project references; large dataset payloads were not downloaded. Observed revisions are source locations, not certification of historical subset parity.

chartography.note: Official README names this HF repository, but anonymous access returned 401. Obtain access or an authorized local release. The two GitHub dummy samples are NOT the 100-question benchmark. Import original data.parquet plus charts with prepare --bench chartography. No public accessibility or dataset redistribution is claimed.

mimic.note: Use common/oddone/listing 1000 each and balanced Counting 5000, not the unbalanced extension or raw-ID-deduplicated 2500. The current prepare entry expects the project's normalized mimic_*.json and ordered images; downloading HF Parquet does not by itself recreate that normalization.

mmsi.note: Use MMSI_Bench.parquet and the existing prepare --bench mmsi path; preserve 1000 examples and original ordered image bytes.

spar.note: Download the four data/test-*.parquet shards, not SPAR-7M training data, Tiny or RGBD. Existing prepare imports all four shards and requires the project profile's 7211 rows/20 tasks. Upstream README says 7207; do not silently reduce the denominator to match that prose.

mmlongbench.note: Extract 0_mmlb_data.tar.gz, 1_vrag_image.tar.gz, 2_mm-niah_image.tar.gz and 2_vh_image.tar.gz. Evaluate the selected five visual families at K8/16/32/64/128 only. Downloading the whole repository may also fetch unused ICL/Counting/document assets.

milebench.note: Download all MileBench_part*.tar.gz components and follow the release's archive instructions. Existing prepare converts the original task JSON/images into the project test29 profile; do not mix adv scores.

memlens.note: Use all four context annotations and referenced images, retain session/system/date and message order, then prepare --bench memlens with the original release image root. Each context must contain 789 questions.

erqa.note: HF provides converted Parquet/TSV with visual_indices already applied and image order changed. The project's existing prepare expects ORIGINAL data/erqa.tfrecord from the official GitHub release. Do not pass converted Parquet to that importer or apply visual_indices twice.

viewspatial.note: Use ViewSpatial-Bench.json plus scannetv2_val.zip and val2017.zip; preserve paths and 5712 records. Run existing prepare --bench viewspatial before inference.

mindcube.note: Extract data.zip and follow the official raw_qa generation instructions. Import MindCube_tinybench_raw_qa.jsonl, not the full benchmark or cognitive-map prompts. Project Tiny distribution is 250 around/200 rotation/600 among. A raw Tiny JSONL is not automatically the raw_qa input_prompt schema.

agentvista.note: Run existing prepare --bench agentvista on the downloaded Parquet directory; requires the selected 209 questions, exports original image bytes and preserves the project's free-tool/final-answer scoring profile.

screenspot_pro.note: Obtain annotations and full original screenshot assets, not resized thumbnails or another split. Project profile requires 1581 en/positive/instruction tasks. Check current archive contents before extraction.

ui_vision.note: Use original images and annotations/element_grounding basic/functional/spatial; preserve the 1772/1772/1935 project denominators. Layout/action tasks are not part of this reported profile.

mmstar.note: HF mmstar.parquet/TSV is original data. The platform preparation entry expects the authorized 1500-row project-normalized query/system/response/images release, preserving exact option and prompt formatting; upstream download alone is not that conversion.

babyvision.note: Use the 388-question BabyVision benchmark, not BabyVision-Gen (280). Project platform preparation expects the normalized original query/system/gold/custom-judge format, not the separate upstream boxed-answer scorer.

vstar.note: 191 high-resolution image questions: direct_attributes (115) and relative_position (76), not OCR/GPT4V-hard or the unrelated video V-STaR dataset. convert reads the paired original JSON/JPG folders, verifies all 191 raw metadata fingerprints, and restores project shortened options and fixed option order with content-free field slices. The official original options[0] determines the gold after reordering. Legacy prepare still imports project-normalized JSONL.

hr4k.note: Use hr_bench_4k.parquet or matching TSV, 800 rows. It shares the download repository with HR-8K but not its split. Project prepare expects the retained hrbench-4k-shuf-imgplaceholder.jsonl normalization.

hr8k.note: Use hr_bench_8k.parquet or matching TSV, 800 rows; do not replace with HR-4K images. Project prepare expects hrbench-8k-shuf-imgplaceholder.jsonl.

mme_en.note: Use MME_RealWorld.json and original image archives, 23609 normalized QA rows; not classic MME or MME-RealWorld-Lite. Some image archives are split parts. Project platform importer expects mme-realworld-shuf-NasPic-imgplaceholder.jsonl.

mme_cn.note: Use MME_RealWorld_CN.json and the matching Chinese image assets, 5917 normalized QA rows; not English/Lite/classic MME. Project platform importer expects mme-realworld-cn-shuf-NasPic-imgplaceholder.jsonl.

zoombench.note: Use all 845 full-image questions from data/test.parquet, not crop_image or a crop/search method. Preserve original query/response; project platform importer expects pbench-shuf-NasPic-imgplaceholder.jsonl.

perception.note: Use PerceptionBench.jsonl, 3000 questions with image data URIs and original problem/hint fields; not the unrelated medical or vision-judge datasets sharing this name. Project importer expects perceptionbench.jsonl normalized prompt/images.

treebench.note: Use TreeBench.tsv, 405 rows; not TreeVGR training sets. Project reports platform answer accuracy, not the extra grounding-IoU metric; importer expects treebench-shuf-imgplaceholder.jsonl.

o3.note: Use test/metadata.jsonl plus test/images, 345 chart/map questions. Preserve question/options/answer and layout fields. InSight-o3/O3-Bench returned 401; use this accessible author repository. Project importer expects insight-o3.jsonl normalization.

countqa.note: Source is image-level with parallel questions/answers lists. Expand aligned QA pairs for the project's 1528 question denominator; not the number of image rows or a lite sample. Importer expects countqa-shuf-imgplaceholder.jsonl, retaining original platform query/system.
